customReplacement.reason: The owner-selected evidence-led editorial system requires product-specific evidence ledgers, source receipts, and audit marks that no upstream block provides as one coherent system.

contract.purpose: Make AI brand visibility explainable by keeping the answer, source context, competitor narrative, and next action together.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Help founders and marketing teams understand where their brand is discussed, how it compares with competitors, and which evidence gaps deserve action.
contract.driftNote: Fleet catalog metadata still marks MentionPilot archived and inactive; the current repository PRD and implemented product workflow are authoritative for this review.
contract.audience: Product-aware founders and marketing leads who distrust vanity metrics and need the answer behind the score.
contract.job: Run a brand check, inspect the exact evidence, identify a narrative gap, and turn it into defensible follow-up work.
contract.thesis: AI visibility is useful only when the answer behind it remains inspectable.
contract.system: A warm editorial signal room built from paper fields, black rules, coral audit marks, evidence sheets, and a single dark closing register.
contract.signature: The evidence ledger links every result to its question, response excerpt, source receipt, coverage state, and next action.
contract.risk: Editorial styling could become decorative or obscure coverage limits; explicit illustrative labels, accessible contrast, and retained error states keep the interface honest.

projectCheck.command: cd apps/web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build

comprehension.reviewer: First-viewport comprehension review in Chrome at 390, 768, and 1440 pixels

answers.product: An evidence-first AI brand intelligence workspace that records how configured AI assistants describe a brand.
answers.audience: Founders and marketing teams responsible for a brand's market narrative.
answers.value: It replaces opaque visibility scores with inspectable answers and actionable source gaps.
answers.mechanism: Run discovery questions, retain responses, citations, and status, compare competitor positioning, and turn gaps into work.
answers.proof: The opening view demonstrates the record structure with a clearly labelled illustrative question, answer, source receipt, and check metadata.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner selected Signal Room, said they loved the direction, and requested a calmer top hero. The implementation retains the editorial evidence system while reducing the hero scale.
